Description: Sign-in with company account and role-based access
Original Text: Users sign in with their company account and see only what their role allows.
Administrators add and remove users and assign roles.

Description: Create work orders with customer, address, priority and due date
Original Text: Dispatchers create work orders with a customer, address, priority and due date.
Work orders move through states: new, scheduled, in progress, done, cancelled.

Description: Assign work orders to technicians on a calendar
Original Text: Dispatchers assign work orders to technicians on a calendar.

Description: Technician availability and travel time on the calendar
Original Text: The calendar shows each technician's availability and travel time between jobs.

Description: Technician day view on a phone, offline capable
Original Text: Technicians see their day's jobs on a phone, offline if needed.

Description: Completion capture: notes, photos, customer signature
Original Text: Technicians record notes, photos and the customer's signature on completion.

Description: Customer SMS when the technician is on the way
Original Text: Customers receive an SMS when a technician is on the way.

Description: Work orders created from CRM tickets
Original Text: Work orders are created automatically from our CRM tickets.
Parts used on a job are deducted from the van stock.

Description: Manager dashboards: jobs completed, first-time fix rate, overdue work
Original Text: Managers see dashboards for jobs completed, first-time fix rate and overdue work.

Description: Completed jobs sent to billing with labour time and parts
Original Text: Completed jobs are sent to billing with labour time and parts.
